# Afnan Javed

> Official personal website and portfolio of Afnan Javed, a Pakistan based software platform founder focused on business systems, custom digital solutions and AI automation. His name may also be written as Afnan Jawed.

Canonical website: https://afnanjaved.com/

## About
Afnan Javed builds and operates business software platforms. He works with businesses and organizations on software, operations and automation. His education includes higher secondary studies; much of his practical experience comes from working on real projects.

## Founded platforms
- [Dinaaro](https://dinaaro.com/): Retail management software focused on sales, stock, supplier and customer ledgers, and daily business operations.
- [EduPulse](https://edupulse.com/): Education management system focused on school records, communication with families and learning support.

## Selected business collaborations
- Switch Power Co., Saudi Arabia: Electrical and lighting business digital experience.
- Nexus Tech, Pakistan: Digital products, subscriptions and customer experience.
